products.description:
Stay cool and dry with the adidas Women's Z.N.E. Tank Top - Light Pink, designed for a slim fit that hugs your form without restricting movement. Featuring advanced materials that wick and disperse sweat, this tank ensures a distraction-free performance. The matte rubber print three-bar logo and tech-inspired drawcords add a modern touch, making it a versatile piece for any lifestyle occasion.
  • Slim fit
  • Doubleknit: 75% polyester (100% recycled), 25% elastane
  • Crew neck
  • CLIMACOOL te
